brine_check.reading: At the boom pace ~15 caverns leach at once (Etzel alone had 26 in 2009, so consistent) and Germany put ~40 Mm3/yr of brine somewhere; a 100-cavern H2 build needs ~340 Mm3 over 7-9 years. The live constraint to check is whether that outfall capacity (Jade, Ems, salt works) is still permitted.
